pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:58 DealView queries remote evidence and transcripts through component-scoped hooks that discard responses on unmount and reload cold on remount without cache reuse or request deduplication.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:58 Evidence and transcript queries are held in component-scoped state via useQuery with no module-scoped cache, resetting to empty on unmount and forcing cold remounts.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:57 Queries lack fresh/stale window thresholds and background revalidation, setting loading: true and clearing data on every mount instead of painting stale while refreshing.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/deal/Evidence.tsx:63 ProofPanel renders a loading placeholder despite evidence already being loaded in the parent Book list cache (evidence.ts), failing to borrow warmth from sibling summary entries.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:64 Read operations bind commands and parameters directly to component hooks rather than declaring reusable plain-value triples (key, fetcher, policy) callable by prefetchers or loaders.
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:59 Identical read requests across concurrently mounting surfaces execute separate backend invokes without an in-flight join registry.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:40 While secondary tab chunks are deferred to idle, their underlying data fetches (like deal_evidence) are dispatched eagerly at mount rather than deferred to idle or tab visibility.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:77 Derivations over clauses and deal rules rely on component-scoped React useMemo tied to the component mount cycle rather than a content-identity keyed derivation cache.
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:61 Query arguments are passed as ad-hoc objects/literals without a dedicated key builder or versioning discipline.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:66 Fresh updates are pushed into an isolated single-entry React state hook rather than governed by an explicit admission hypothesis or cache retention policy.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/DealView.tsx:51 DealView subscribes to the shared world context while issuing separate local queries with independent refresh policies without cross-claimant quantifier reconciliation.

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/deal/Evidence.tsx:79 Market comparables are retrieved by exact item reference and certified server-side; client UI renders market comparison bands without client-side resemblance or paraphrase admission caches.

pairs.subject: client-fetch-cache
pairs.evidence: crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:136 The market data client implements an unbounded in-memory cache without eviction, in-flight deduplication, or stale-while-revalidate fallback upon fetch errors.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:142 Concurrent calls to comparables for the same product and currency issue duplicate network requests because the client lacks an in-flight join registry.

crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:137 When a cached entry is due for refresh, the client blocks synchronously and fails completely if the network call errors instead of serving the stale cached band with background revalidation.
crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:41 The cache stores every fetched comparables result in an unbounded BTreeMap without an explicit admission hypothesis, size cap, or eviction reaper.
crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:108 Cache keys are assembled ad-hoc as string tuples at lookup and insertion points rather than through a single key builder with canonical serialization or versioning.
crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:150 Raw response hashing is used for cryptographic integrity checks rather than as an acceleration derive cache for recomputed layouts or aggregations.

crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:116 Although Channel3 provides similar product comparables, the client's local cache is keyed strictly by exact product identity and currency rather than resemblance metrics.
crates/table-runtime/src/market.rs:105 Market data refreshes occur on explicit actor command calls without speculative intent prefetching or idle-time deferral.
crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:50 The market client has a single global freshness policy evaluated at read time, with no plural claimants specifying distinct cache lifetimes or options.
crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:37 Client is a long-lived backend service component that does not participate in view mounting or unmounting lifecycles.
crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:32 MarketApi defines an asynchronous Rust trait interface rather than a client-side portable read definition bound to UI reactive primitives.
crates/table-market/src/lib.rs:104 MarketRef lookups are individual product queries that do not have parent listings or sibling collection entries from which summary warmth can be borrowed.
